title: Multiparametric Ultrasound for the Diagnosis of Clinically Significant Prostate Cancer
official: Prostate Cancer Diagnosis by Multiparametric Ultrasound (Mp-US) - Targeted Biopsy; Targeted Biopsy Cores Based on Mp-US Compared With Targeted Biopsy Based on Mp-MRI, for Detection of Clinically Significant PCa.
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn whether multiparametric ultrasound (mp-US) can detect clinically significant prostate cancer as effectively as multiparametric MRI (mp-MRI) in adult men undergoing prostate biopsy for suspected prostate cancer.

The main questions it aims to answer are:

Does mp-US-guided targeted biopsy detect clinically significant prostate cancer at a rate that is not inferior to mp-MRI-guided targeted biopsy? Can mp-US imaging collected at the time of biopsy be used to identify suspicious prostate lesions for targeted sampling?

Researchers will compare mp-US-guided targeted biopsy plus systematic biopsy with mp-MRI-guided targeted biopsy plus systematic biopsy to see if mp-US achieves a similar detection rate for clinically significant prostate cancer.

Participants will:

Undergo mp-MRI within 30 days before prostate biopsy. Receive mp-US imaging at the time of biopsy. Undergo up to three mp-US-targeted biopsy cores of suspicious areas. Undergo up to three mp-MRI-targeted biopsy cores of suspicious areas. Receive a standard systematic prostate biopsy consisting of 12 biopsy cores.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Individuals must meet all of the following inclusion criteria in order to be eligible to participate in the study:

* Subject must be scheduled for a prostate biopsy, based on an elevated PSA (\>3.0ng/ml per most recent NCCN guidelines, elevated PSA velocity (\>0.75ng/ml/year), or abnormal digital rectal examination.
* Subject must be able and willing to give written informed consent for a contrast enhanced ultrasound study of the prostate including the additional study biopsies.
* Subject must be a male at least 18 years of age when informed consent is obtained.

Exclusion Criteria:

An individual who meets any of the following criteria will be excluded from participation in this study:

* Participant in a clinical trial involving an investigational drug within the past 30 days.
* Patients with known or suspected hypersensitivity to perflutren, PEG, or any other component of Definity
* Previous treatment for prostate cancer, including hormone therapy.
* Clinically unstable, severely ill, or moribund as per treating physician.
